workItem: P8.76 Packaged Executable Launch Smoke Boundary Plan
purpose: Define the future boundary for launching the packaged WindowsUtility executable from a sandbox only after package extraction inventory verification and explicit launch authorization exist.

preconditions.description: The existing WindowsUtility package must first pass sandboxed extraction inventory verification.
The user/coordinator must explicitly authorize packaged executable launch smoke.
preconditions.requiredAcceptedResponse: accept sandboxed packaged executable launch smoke

preconditions.description: Launch smoke must not require credentials, provider API calls, installer creation, signing, or release authority.
WindowsUtility target repo must remain clean/aligned before and after smoke.

futureAllowedIfAuthorizedLater: launch packaged executable from sandbox extraction directory
record stdout/stderr/log files produced inside sandbox only
optionally capture UI screenshot only if a separate screenshot authorization exists
